name: Sergeant Hale
title: Waykeeper Sergeant
examine: Twenty years on the marches and a ledger of every camp broken and every mile held. Polishes the brazier like it outranks him.
lines: This post holds fourteen miles of road. Some days it holds them by one lamp and my mood.
Brigands ambush the toll bends. Wolves work the trail. Kobolds take the rest. Everyone's got a trade.
The one in the pen? Caught him stealing our boots. IN our boots.
Our lamps stop where the road stops being walked. Halla's stop where she says they do. We were both right once, in the same ditch.
